body: Owner decision (after adversarial review rounds 2/5/9): audit.mjs must not silently default to the previous release. A run without an ADLC target (argv[2] / ADLC_TARGET_VERSION) and an agy target (argv[4] / AGY_TARGET_VERSION) exits 1 before any probing, with a usage message that names the 1.12.0 / 1.4.7 command and the trust-anchor helper. The pinned refs keep their derived defaults. Update skills/modernize/SKILL.md usage text, sync mirrors with npm run skills:sync, and update test/modernize-skill.test.mjs so every audit invocation passes explicit targets (the pipeline tests keep their 1.12.0 ADLC and 1.2.8 agy fixtures) and add a test that a no-target run is refused. Acceptance: npm test green; the new test fails without the change.
title: Modernize audit requires explicit release targets
